paragraphs.text: Morophon , the Boundless , is a shapeshifter from an unknown plane in the multiverse .

Morophon is a colorless changeling shapeshifter that can appear as any creature type . In one of its forms, it appears as a large four-legged creature with an antlered humanoid head and various horns coming out of its skin. It appears to inhabit a mountainous area of a plane that also has other animals like bears , elk , and elephants .
